key_points: ConocoPhillips signed a long-term LNG supply deal with Venture Global (Oct 5, 2026).
Jefferies raised its price target and Truist increased target to $136, reflecting optimism.
Analysts note the LNG contract supports cash flow visibility amid firm crude and LNG demand.
RBC Capital maintained its rating ahead of upcoming earnings, indicating no near‑term concerns.
Overall news flow is positive, with multiple outlets highlighting the deal as a catalyst.
